rawContent: And I’ll add that I imagine part of the #MeToo moment is that women who learned about consent and sexual autonomy on campus are now in the workplace and expect better treatment. #IPCSummit2018
On #MeToo backlash, @SofieRKarasek says: “When you do the right thing, the opposition will get organized. You’re doing it right when they’re mad at you.” #MichMeeting18

When it comes to the question of, “What do we do with the perpetrators?” @SofieRKarasek argues we should ask what survivors want and what is best for survivors. Survivors deserve justice AND healing. #MichMeeting18 #MeToo #RestorativeJustice
